SfdcPartnerPayout.name: SfdcPartnerPayout
SfdcPartnerPayout.description: Represents an invoice payout from Stripe to a partner in a Partner Business Org (PBO).

Amount.description: The net amount of all invoices, subtracting the partner net revenue (PNR) and taxes, in a 30 day period. Value is shown in cents and must be converted to dollars.

ArrivalDate.description: The date that a partner can expect a payout to arrive in their designated bank account. The value factors in delays for weekends and bank holidays.

BankAccountNumber.description: The last four digits of the bank account number where the payout is sent.

CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code of the currency for the payout.

DestinationBankName.description: Name of the destination bank for the payout.

ExternalId.description: The external ID for the payout record from Stripe.

Id.description: System field. The unique identifier for the record.

ReferenceToken.description: The payout reference token from Stripe that appears on bank statements for reconciliation.
